desc:
👕 2 Player Knockout!👕
Team up inside one giant shirt and battle other duos! Work together, knock opponents off the arena, and be the last duo standing!

🥊 FIGHT TOGETHER
Punch, shove, and dash your way to victory. Stay coordinated—or take your teammate down with you!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
🤝 Team up with a partner and share one shirt
🥊 Knock rival duos off the island
⚡ Dash to dodge attacks and escape danger
🧵 Try different equipment with different abilities

👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE if you enjoy the game!
